subject: FusePrompt integration: Redwood adapter + telemetry & marketplace onboarding
messages:
From: Alan Kim <alan@fuseprompt.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@fuseprompt.com>
Date: 2026-10-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Redwood adapter + telemetry integration interest

Hi Michael,

Thanks for taking the meeting last week — excited to follow up. FusePrompt is building an enterprise prompt orchestration layer (multi-embedding + reranking) and a subset of our customers are asking for a production-grade inference runtime with low token cost and predictable latency. We evaluated Redwood's hosted and dedicated options and believe an official adapter (LangChain / LlamaIndex friendly) + a telemetry contract would get us to GA faster.

High-level asks:
- A supported adapter/reference binding for LangChain and LlamaIndex (we prefer minimal surface area: connection string + API key + optional KV cache hints).
- Tracing/telemetry contract: we want to capture request_id, model_variant, latency_ms, token_counts (prompt/completion), and error codes to map to our observability.
- Marketplace listing & co-marketing (short partner listing + joint blog/demo).

Can Redwood share a short SOW template (scope, deliverables, timeline) and a ballpark commercial for a dedicated small cluster + integration support? Also attaching our minimal architecture diagram and a sample QPS profile.

If you want, we can do a 30-minute sync next week to scope deliverables and owners.

Attachments: fuseprompt-arch-diagram.pdf (architecture diagram), qps-sample.csv (token/QPS samples)

—Alan
Director of Integrations
FusePrompt

From: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
To: Alan Kim <alan@fuseprompt.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-26T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood adapter + telemetry integration interest

Alan — great to hear from you and thanks for the attachments (opened the diagram). I looped in Marissa (ISV integrations lead) and Vanessa (partner GTM) so we can coordinate scope and commerce.

Quick clarifying questions before the sync:
1) Adapter surface: do you need server-side SDKs (Python/Node) or are you expecting a connector that sits inside LangChain/LlamaIndex as a provider?
2) Telemetry schema: the fields you listed are fine; we typically also include model_config_name and quantization_profile when present. Do you need raw token payloads (we generally avoid transmitting prompts to partners without a contract) or just aggregated token counts?
3) Security: will FusePrompt require private deployment (VPC) or are you OK with Redwood Hosted with a dedicated pool? Any regulatory constraints (SOC2, EU data residency)?

We can send an internal SOW template and a pricing sketch for a small Dedicated pool + 4 weeks of engineering runbook for adapter + 1 month of integration support. Vanessa — can you prepare a draft partner listing and co-marketing outline? Marissa — can you own the technical acceptance criteria and an adapter POC checklist?

Proposed times for a 30-min tech + commercial sync: Tue 10/28 11:00am PT, Wed 10/29 2:00pm PT. Which works for you?

Attachments referenced: adapter-checklist-template.docx (we will attach a first draft after internal alignment)

Thanks,
—Michael
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Alan Kim <alan@fuseprompt.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@fuseprompt.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-27T08:21:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Redwood adapter + telemetry integration interest

Michael, Marissa — thanks for the quick reply. Short answers:
- Adapter: Python + Node server-side SDKs would be ideal; a LangChain provider implementation is also high-value. We can take a compatibility-first approach: a minimal provider shim + examples for LangChain and LlamaIndex.
- Telemetry: aggregated token counts (prompt/completion) + request_id and model_variant are sufficient for our initial needs. We are happy to execute a DPA for any tracing payloads that include user content.
- Security: most customers will accept Redwood Hosted in a dedicated pool. A small subset (financial services) will require VPC/private deployment down the road, but that can be a later phase. We are SOC 2 Type II in progress — happy to share evidence during onboarding.

We reviewed your sample pricing ranges offline and a small dedicated pool + 4-week integration support fits our budget. I'll get internal approval for a pilot deal and can sign an MOU. I've uploaded a short adapter proposal and architecture PDF (attached). Also sharing a DocuSign placeholder: https://docusign.example.com/usid-9b2f3a

We can do Tue 10/28 11:00am PT — Alan + Priya will join. Please send a calendar invite with the agenda: (1) POC scope (LangChain + LlamaIndex examples), (2) Telemetry fields & schema, (3) Timeline & owners, (4) Marketplace listing draft.

Attachments: adapter-proposal.xlsx, fuseprompt-arch-diagram.pdf

—Alan
